name: XpandPack | Slim & expandable water-resistant laptop backpack
snippet:
Compartment for tablets of up to 12 in. · Two frontal zipper pockets · Carry-on strap.
This expandable backpack adapts to your on-the-go needs and keeps you comfortable in any conditions. It fits a laptop up to 15.6", all your smaller tech goodies, important documents and more. If you need extra space, the main compartment can expand by two thirds its size!
